title: GitHub - KeplSiv/FolderForge: Native macOS folder icon designer. Customize folders with colors, symbols, gradients, presets, and recursive workspace styling.
excerpt: Native macOS folder icon designer. Customize folders with colors, symbols, gradients, presets, and recursive workspace styling. - KeplSiv/FolderForge
content_html:
Customize macOS folder icons with colors, images, symbols, text, emoji, or ICNS files.

Download the latest DMG · macOS 14+

Features

  • Color and gradient folder designs
  • Image fills with optional overlays
  • SF Symbols, emoji, and text
  • Full ICNS import
  • Reusable presets and recursive folder imports
  • Smart Style rules for applying designs across a folder tree
  • Restore original icons and undo the last batch
  • Native SwiftUI app with no third-party dependencies

Smart Style

Smart Style matches folders by name, path, marker files, or file types. For example, every folder named Receipts can automatically use the same preset across an entire workspace. It shows every proposed change before anything is applied. Scans default to one level deep, skip common build and system folders, and stop at 2,000 folders.

Install

Download the DMG from Releases, move FolderForge to Applications, then open it.

The GitHub build is currently ad-hoc signed rather than notarized. On first launch, right-click FolderForge, choose Open, then confirm.

To build it yourself:

git clone https://github.com/KeplSiv/FolderForge.git
cd FolderForge
./build.sh --run

Requires macOS 14+ and the Xcode command line tools.

Safety and privacy

FolderForge works locally. It has no accounts, analytics, telemetry, or network features.

Before replacing a custom icon, FolderForge saves the original so it can be restored. It may request access to folders you choose. Finder Automation permission is only used when importing the current Finder selection.

See the privacy policy.

Command line

The app binary also provides a CLI:

FF=/Applications/FolderForge.app/Contents/MacOS/FolderForge
$FF --apply ~/Projects --preset Code
$FF --apply ~/Notes --color '#FF9F0A' --emoji '📓' --finish natural
$FF --apply ~/Code --recursive --exclude 'node_modules,dist,build' --dry-run
$FF --reset ~/Projects
$FF --help

Development

swift test
./build.sh --run
./build.sh --dmg

FolderForge is built with Swift and SwiftUI. Licensed under the MIT License.

content_html_zh:
使用颜色、图像、符号、文本、表情符号或 ICNS 文件自定义 macOS 文件夹图标。

下载最新的 DMG·macOS 14+

特征

  • 颜色和渐变文件夹设计
  • 图像填充有可选的叠加层
  • SF 符号、表情符号和文本
  • 完整的 ICNS 导入
  • 可重复使用的预设和递归文件夹导入
  • 用于跨文件夹树应用设计的智能样式规则
  • 恢复原来的图标并撤消上一批
  • 原生 SwiftUI 应用程序，无第三方依赖项

智能风格

智能样式按名称、路径、标记文件或文件类型匹配文件夹。 例如，每个名为 Receipts 的文件夹都可以在整个工作区中自动使用相同的预设。 它会在应用任何内容之前显示每个建议的更改。 扫描默认为一层深度，跳过常见的构建和系统文件夹，并在 2,000 个文件夹处停止。

安装

从 Releases 下载 DMG，将FolderForge 移动到Applications，然后打开它。

GitHub 构建目前是临时签名而不是经过公证。 首次启动时，右键单击“FolderForge”，选择“打开”，然后确认。

自己构建：

git clone https://github.com/KeplSiv/FolderForge.git
cd FolderForge
./build.sh --run

需要 macOS 14+ 和 Xcode 命令行工具。

安全和隐私

FolderForge 在本地工作。 它没有帐户、分析、遥测或网络功能。

在替换自定义图标之前，FolderForge 会保存原始图标，以便可以将其恢复。 它可能会请求访问您选择的文件夹。 Finder 自动化权限仅在导入当前 Finder 选择时使用。

请参阅隐私政策。

命令行

该应用程序二进制文件还提供了一个 CLI：

FF=/Applications/FolderForge.app/Contents/MacOS/FolderForge
$FF --apply ~/Projects --preset Code
$FF --apply ~/Notes --color '#FF9F0A' --emoji '📓' --finish natural
$FF --apply ~/Code --recursive --exclude 'node_modules,dist,build' --dry-run
$FF --reset ~/Projects
$FF --help

发展

swift test
./build.sh --run
./build.sh --dmg

FolderForge 是使用 Swift 和 SwiftUI 构建的。 根据 MIT 许可证获得许可。
